tools.name: search_records
tools.description: Search Skyline's certified (human-reviewed) records on Oklahoma property insurance, roofing regulation, and insurance-industry news (carrier ratings, agency M&A). Free — no API key required. All params optional and combinable.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Get a single certified record by its record_id.

tools.name: get_record_history
tools.description: Get the full revision lineage for a record — every certified record it supersedes or was superseded by, oldest first.

tools.name: list_changes_since
tools.description: Poll for what's changed since a given date/time instead of re-pulling the whole dataset: newly certified records, superseded (old->new) pairs, and reconfirmed records. Underlying sources are re-checked weekly (Sundays, 00:00 UTC).
